integrity: All displayed bounds are analytical with explicit normalizations. Standalone finite tests supplement rather than replace proofs; classical cubature symmetry and published universal defect bounds are attributed.
scientific_limitations: Exactly planar trace-free quadratic defects; stability only for five positive atoms at excess at most 1e-8; stability constants are sufficient rather than sharp; no theorem on full BSDE discretization or independent priority certification.
title: The four-to-five-state defect transition and stable pentagon rigidity
